\begin{abstract}
Picture our everyday universe---three directions of space plus time---as a thin four-dimensional sheet floating inside a possible hidden fifth dimension. In our companion work IGRT-2026-H11, clocks and quantum measurements follow precise mathematical laws strictly on that four-dimensional sheet. Here, IGRT-2026-H12 asks whether stepping off our sheet into an unseen fifth spatial coordinate y could ever fold proper time, shorten cosmic travel, or turn black holes and entangled particles into "portals"---defined rigorously throughout this work as mathematical connections, never macroscopic traversable wormholes.

Across 13 chapters and Consolidated Appendices A--L, our headline conclusion for both general readers and physicists is clear: no 5D phenomenon has been observed, everyday four-dimensional H11 physics stays completely unchanged below 4.485 meV ($R_{5} \le 44 \mu m$), and our strongest results are Category B negative proofs that rule out popular extra-dimensional myths. Ordinary flat extra dimensions ($M_{4} \times S^{1}$) strictly slow light down ($L_{5}/L_{4} =$ 1.001249), standard symmetric Randall--Sundrum warped bulks keep light speed unchanged everywhere ($c_{\mathrm{eff}}(y) =$ c; Horizon Theorem $\Delta t_{5}/\Delta t_{4} =$ 1.010321), regular Hayward black holes are sealed objects rather than portals, and holding open a macroscopic wormhole requires $10^{71}$ times more negative energy than physical vacuum fluctuations can supply.

Faster bulk paths through a fifth dimension (Beltrami ratios $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}} =$ 0.86634..0.07770 and finite-span Einstein--Maxwell 0.84147, horizon limit $2/\pi =$ 0.63662) appear strictly as Category C (Conjectural) geometric classifications assuming an unobserved asymmetric warp; no physical mechanism is currently known that could produce the asymmetric warp required for shortcuts. Meanwhile, double-slit wave--particle duality ($V^{2} + D_{\mathrm{QFI}}^{2} =$ 1) lives inside quantum state space independently of 5D, the Born rule remains a Category A postulate, and entanglement still forbids faster-than-light communication. Real experiments separate cleanly into bulk searches (P7--P10), presently unattainable active folding tests (P11--P12), and a passive neutron-star merger arrival bound (Protocol P13, $|\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{GW}-\mathrm{EM}} -$ 1\textbar{} $\le 4.129 \times 10^{-16}$). Eleven laboratory devices and analog systems (Devices A--K, Appendix J)---spanning atomic QFI clocks, Casimir vacuum harvesters, photonic portal cavities, Deutsch closed-time-loop emulators, and Unruh thermal engines---pair exact equations with strict non-overclaiming boundaries, while \S{}13.5 and Appendix K summarize how Eqs. (H12.0.1)--(H12.0.2) unify seven core open problems in modern physics. Protocol P13 is a passive bound from existing data, not an active test of the folding mechanism. No active test of the folding mechanism is currently feasible.

\end{abstract}

\section*{Epistemic Boundaries, Preserved H11 Foundations \& Explicit Non-Claims}
\begin{itemize}
  \item H11 Integrity Preserved: Nothing in H12 alters, retracts, or invalidates the 4D predictions of IGRT-2026-H11 (verified by 665 assertions in \texttt{scripts/verify-igrt-monograph.mjs}). H11 remains the exact effective 4D low-energy limit (E $\ll 4.485$ meV) of H12.
  \item Fifth Dimension Status (Category C): H12 treats the physical fifth dimension y as a mathematically consistent, conditionally falsifiable theoretical extension---NOT an established experimental fact.
  \item No Free Wormholes, Perpetual Free Energy, or Warp Drives (Category B Negative Theorems): Ordinary 4D Hayward regular black holes do NOT violate NEC and are NOT portals. \subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
Imagine walking across a vast, flat sheet of paper. Everything you can see, measure, and touch---left--right, forward--backward, up--down, plus the ticking flow of time---lives on that four-dimensional sheet (known in physics as a 4D brane). Our companion monograph, IGRT-2026-H11, showed how physical time itself emerges smoothly on that four-dimensional sheet from quantum information geometry. This second work, IGRT-2026-H12, asks a simple, natural "what if": could our universe actually sit inside a five-dimensional room (an unseen bulk with one extra spatial direction y), and if so, could anything ever take a shortcut through it?

Why Intellectual Honesty Matters First: Ideas about extra dimensions often inspire dramatic science-fiction claims about wormholes, instant travel, or faster-than-light quantum messaging. Before chasing such possibilities, Chapter 1 draws an unmistakable line between proven mathematics, unproven conjectures, and real experiments. Throughout this monograph, the word "portal" strictly denotes a mathematical geometric or state-space connection---never a sci-fi traversable tunnel---and Chapter 9 summarizes exact negative theorems showing why ordinary black holes, flat extra circles, and tabletop vacuum cavities cannot act as shortcuts.

How This Monograph Is Organized: This follow-up work intentionally separates established negative proofs from conjectural five-dimensional possibilities and laboratory analog systems. Readers seeking the strongest scientific content should go directly to Chapter 9 (Negative Results Summary). Readers seeking the positive conjectures should go to Chapter 4 (Beltrami Geodesics, Category C). Readers seeking experimental tests should go to Chapter 12 (Protocols P7--P13). Readers seeking non-technical orientation alongside structured comparisons should consult this introduction together with Chapter 2's opening overview, Tables 1.1--1.3, and the Glossary of 5D Terms at the end of Chapter 1, while technical auditors should inspect Chapter 2 (5D action variation $\delta S_{\mathrm{total}}/\delta G^{AB} =$ 0, regulators, and E\"{o}t-Wash bounds), Chapters 4--6, and Chapter 7.

Standardized Metric Signature \& Grey-Area Discipline: Throughout IGRT-H12, four-dimensional spacetime $M_{4}$ carries strict mostly-plus Lorentzian signature ($-$, $+$, $+$, $+$), and its five-dimensional extension $M_{5} = M_{4} \times K_{1}$ carries ($-$, $+$, $+$, $+$, $+$) where the fifth coordinate y is spacelike $(+dy^{2})$. The metric signature is $(-,+,+,+,+)$. Mixed signatures are excluded. Foundational equations declaration: Eqs. (H12.0.1) and (H12.0.2) are postulated, not derived. They define the 5D hypothesis. To resolve grey-area edge cases between Derived (Category B) and Conjectural (Category C), H12 enforces the Category $B/C$ Boundary Rubric Box placed at the opening of Chapter 1 (Table 1.3): any exact mathematical theorem proven unconditionally from Category A or H11 premises (such as negative obstruction theorems) receives Category B, whereas any variational calculation whose physical background metric or radion potential is postulated rather than derived from a ghost-free 5D action is quarantined strictly in Category C.

\section{Modular Time and Temporal Folding}
\vspace{20pt}
\noindent\textit{Introduces why "time" splits into seven distinct concepts, contrasts them against Connes--Rovelli, ADM, and Braunstein--Caves literature, defines component-wise $$\mathcal{F}$_{AB}$, proves gauge invariance of $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}$, and verifies full Model 3 conversions.}

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
In everyday conversation, the single word "time" feels completely unambiguous: it is the steady reading displayed by a wristwatch between sunrise and noon. Inside foundational theoretical physics, however, packing seven unrelated mathematical objects under that single four-letter noun generates pervasive conceptual error. Across quantum field theory, general relativity, and braneworld cosmology, investigators simultaneously manipulate coordinate chart labels (t), proper clock ticks accumulated on our four-dimensional brane $(\tau _{4})$, hypothetical proper clock ticks accumulated along excursions into a fifth dimension $(\tau _{5})$, operator-algebraic Tomita--Takesaki modular flow $(s_{\mathrm{mod}})$, quantum statistical distinguishability distance $(s_{\mathrm{QFI}})$, equilibrium thermal time $(t_{\mathrm{th}})$, and cosmological Friedmann--Robertson--Walker expansion age $(t_{\mathrm{FRW}})$. Chapter 3 untangles all seven quantities cleanly before a single shortcut theorem is stated.

What "Temporal Folding" Does---and Does Not---Mean: Throughout IGRT-2026-H12, temporal folding is defined quantitatively by the dimensionless ratio $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}} \equiv \Delta \tau _{5} / \Delta \tau _{4}$ comparing proper duration along a bulk trajectory $\gamma _{5}$ against proper duration along a brane reference $\gamma _{4}$ between the exact same start and finish coincidence events on \{y = 0\}. Think of two identical airliners departing Paris simultaneously and landing together in New York: if one climbs into a high-altitude jet stream with stronger tailwinds while the other battles headwinds along sea level, their onboard flight-time clocks legitimately register different elapsed durations upon reunion without reversing causality or breaking chronometers. Analogously, $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}} < 1$ never implies backward time travel, paradoxes, or magic clock interference; it simply asks whether warped five-dimensional geometry permits a bulk clock path to record less proper duration than a confined brane path.

Why Relabeling a Map Never Changes a Real Clock: A notorious trap in curved-spacetime physics is coordinate-gauge illusion. Nothing stops a theorist from rewriting t $\to t' = 0.5$ t on a chalkboard so coordinate time appears twice as fast, yet not a single vibrating strontium atom accelerates because of a change of paper labels. To separate authentic geometric clock compression from empty bookkeeping tricks, Section 3.2 writes out the explicit Jacobian transformation law under arbitrary smooth 5D diffeomorphisms $X^{A} \to \tilde\{X\}^{A}(X)$, proving algebraically that $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}$ is a strictly coordinate-invariant scalar provided both worldlines reconnect smoothly at fixed brane coincidence events A, B $\in$ \{y = 0\} within bounded momentum transfer $|\delta P_{y}| \le m_{KK}^{(1)} c^{-1}$.

Bridging Algebra, Geometry, and Real Laboratory Scales: Beyond clarifying relativity, Chapter 3 connects the operator-algebraic foundations of quantum statistical mechanics---Tomita--Takesaki KMS analyticity and Connes--Rovelli thermal time [20]---directly to Braunstein--Caves Quantum Fisher information distance [10] inside the projective Hilbert fiber PU(H). When generalized to include non-zero ADM shift vectors $N_{\mu}(X)$ in the 4+1 spacetime split, the Temporal Folding Tensor $$\mathcal{F}$_{AB} \equiv e^{2\alpha _{t} k|y|} G_{AB} - g_{AB}^{(4)}$ exposes every physical lapse and frame-dragging bulk mixing term ($$\mathcal{F}$_{0i}$, $$\mathcal{F}$_{\mu y}$, $$\mathcal{F}$_{ij}$) without coordinate ambiguity.

Roadmap of Chapter 3: Section 3.1 assembles all seven orthogonal temporal notions in Table 3.1 alongside standard ADM, Borchers--Haag, Connes--Rovelli, and Page--Wootters literature, deriving component-wise Eq. \section{Higher-Dimensional Geodesics and Spacetime Shortcuts}
\vspace{20pt}
\noindent\textit{Proves analytically across multi-baseline scales and arbitrary conformal warp functions w(y) that flat $S^{1}$ and conformal RS $AdS_{5}$ permit zero shortcuts (Category B), then details Category C Beltrami shooting geodesics with EL and $ds_{5}^{2} = 0$ verification.}

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
Every time popular science discusses a fifth dimension, the same seductive rumor quickly follows: if our three-dimensional universe is curved or tucked inside a higher space, perhaps a beam of light or a spacecraft could dive off our four-dimensional sheet, cut straight across the unseen interior like a chord across a bent ribbon, and beat an ordinary laser beam staying on the surface. Intuition from folded paper maps makes that shortcut sound effortless. Yet intuition built on static Euclidean paper routinely fails inside Einsteinian Lorentzian geometry, where both space distances and clock ticks warp simultaneously.

To settle this question without guesswork, Chapter 4 puts higher-dimensional travel on trial across three progressively subtler geometries. Think first of an ordinary unwarped extra circle (flat Kaluza--Klein space $M_{4} \times S^{1}$): stepping sideways into y adds extra path length by the ordinary Pythagorean theorem without boosting light speed, so every detour---including complex corkscrew windings around the hidden circle---strictly arrives late ($L_{5} > L_{4}$). Next, consider the celebrated Randall--Sundrum warped fifth dimension (conformal $AdS_{5}$ [2]): although gravity bends sharply along y, it shrinks rulers and slows clocks in exact tandem ($\alpha _{t} + \alpha _{x} =$ 0), keeping the effective coordinate speed of light locked strictly at $c_{\mathrm{eff}}(y) =$ c everywhere.

Why Equal Warping Blocks Every Shortcut: Section 4.1 establishes No-Go Theorem 4.1 across arbitrary baselines from one meter to cosmic megaparsecs and proves the Generalized Conformal Horizon Theorem: whenever time and space warp equally along the fifth coordinate, every five-dimensional light beam projects directly inside the ordinary four-dimensional lightcone, guaranteeing $\Delta t_{5} \ge \Delta t_{4}$ with mathematical certainty. Only by breaking that balance---making time and space warp asymmetrically ($\alpha _{t} + \alpha _{x} >$ 0) so clocks run effectively faster deeper inside the bulk---can curved variational geodesics (known as Beltrami arches) beat surface signals along our brane.

A Strict Boundary Between Geometry and Physical Matter: Does nature actually build asymmetric bulks, or do Einstein's equations forbid them? Section 4.2 confronts that question head-on with an exact 5D Null Energy Condition factorization proof. Phenomenological Model 2B ($\alpha _{t} = \alpha _{x} =$ 0.5) yields striking numerical Beltrami shortcuts ($\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}$ down to 0.07770 at span k $\Delta x =$ 50), yet violates positive energy conditions along both brane $(-k^{2})$ and bulk ($-1.5 k^{2}$) null directions and remains unconstructed dynamically. By contrast, ghost-free 5D Einstein--Maxwell theory ($\alpha _{t} =$ 1.0, $\alpha _{x} =$ 0.0) satisfies all null energy conditions cleanly and solves closed-form Beltrami arches---yet enforces an inescapable horizon ceiling k $\Delta x < \pi$ ($\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{EM}} \to 2/\pi =$ 0.63662) and relies on unobserved macroscopic bulk electric flux.

Roadmap of Chapter 4: Section 4.1 derives the exact Cauchy--Schwarz compact-winding inequality and the Poincar\'{e} $AdS_{5}$ horizon bound (Category B). Section 4.2 then quarantines Beltrami shooting solutions strictly inside Category C (classification of possible geometries, not physical prediction), proves affine geodesic ODE closure ($< 2.6 \times 10^{-9}$ residual) alongside point-by-point null microcausality $ds_{5}^{2} =$ 0, and summarizes all results in Tables 4.1--4.2.

\subsection{Negative Theorems: Multi-Baseline $M_{4} \times S^{1}$ \& Generalized Conformal Horizon Theorem \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}
Analytic Flat Compact $M_{4} \times S^{1}$ Multi-Baseline \& Arbitrary-Winding Proof (Category B --- Derived): On flat $ds_{5}^{2} = -c^{2} dt^{2} + dx^{2} + dy^{2}$, null condition $ds_{5}^{2} = 0$ fixes c dt/dx $= dL_{5}/dx = \sqrt(1 + (y')^{2}$) $\ge 1$ identically, with strictly greater inequality $dL_{5}/dx > 1$ wherever y'(x) $\ne$ 0. For ANY piecewise-smooth excursion or non-monotonic compact winding returning to y $= 0$ (total variation $Y_{\mathrm{tot}} = \int |y'(x)|$ dx $>$ 0, including closed windings $Y_{\mathrm{tot}} \ge 2\pi |n| R_{5}$ for winding number n $\ne$ 0), applying the integral Minkowski/Cauchy--Schwarz triangle inequality in $\mathbb{R}^{2}$ gives $L_{5} = \int _{0}^{\Delta x} \sqrt(1 + (y'(x))^{2}$) dx $\ge \sqrt(\Delta x^{2} + Y_{\mathrm{tot}}^{2}$) $> \Delta x = L_{4}$ strictly! For net excursion $Y_{\mathrm{tot}} = \Delta y = 50$ m across benchmark brane spans $\Delta x$: at $\Delta x = 1$ m, $L_{5}/L_{4} = 50.01\times$; at $\Delta x =$ 1,000 m, $L_{5}/L_{4} = 1.001249\times$; at $\Delta x =$ 10,000 km ($10^{7}$ m), $L_{5}/L_{4} = 1 + 1.25 \times 10^{-11} >$ 1; and across an astrophysical 1 Mpc baseline (3.0857 $\times 10^{22}$ m), $L_{5}/L_{4} = 1 + 1.31 \times 10^{-42} >$ 1. Thus flat compactification NEVER produces arrival shortcuts across any laboratory or extragalactic distance.

RS Poincar\'{e} Jacobian \& Analytic Conformal Horizon Proof (Category B --- Derived): On conformal Randall--Sundrum $AdS_{5}$ [2], $ds_{5}^{2} = e^{-2k|y|}(-c^{2} dt^{2} + dx^{2}$) $+ dy^{2}$, applying z(y) $= k^{-1} e^{k|y|}$ yields Jacobian dz/dy $=$ sgn(y) $e^{k|y|} =$ sgn(y) kz, transforming the line element into $ds_{5}^{2} =$ ($kz)^{-2}(-c^{2} dt^{2} + dx^{2} + dz^{2}$). Equivalently, in Eq. \section{Black-Hole Connectivity and Portal Geometry}
\vspace{20pt}
\noindent\textit{Proves analytically and numerically that H11 regular Hayward black holes satisfy both radial and transverse NEC and are NOT portals, embeds them into 5D brane-world black strings with assumed Gregory--Laflamme bounds, and presents a 6-class taxonomy.}

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
Black holes occupy a paradoxical place in the public imagination. On one hand, astronomers now photograph supermassive shadow rings and listen routinely to colliding black-hole mergers with gravitational-wave interferometers. On the other hand, generations of speculative fiction and loose popular articles have blurred non-singular regular black holes---objects whose crushing central infinity is smoothed out by quantum-gravity effects---into traversable cosmic "portals" or secret gateways linking distant stars. Because IGRT-2026-H11 [1] derives a regular Hayward black-hole core characterized by universal length ratio $\xi _{0} = 2^{-1/4} \approx 0.840896$ and crisp gravitational-wave ringdown echo reflectivity $K_{\mathrm{echo}} =$ 0.184, any serious follow-up study in five dimensions must answer an urgent question: is a regular Hayward black hole a doorway to anywhere else?

Chapter 5 delivers an unambiguous mathematical verdict: no. To keep an open traversable throat from collapsing instantly under its own gravity, Einstein's field equations demand exotic negative-pressure stress-energy that violates the Null Energy Condition (NEC), meaning light rays passing the throat must be pushed apart rather than focused inward. An ordinary Schwarzschild black hole destroys travelers at a central singularity; a regular Hayward black hole [6] replaces that central singularity with a smooth, high-density vacuum de Sitter core roughly $r_{\mathrm{core}}$ \textasciitilde{} $10^{-22}$ meters across. Yet replacing a sharp spike with a smooth cushion does NOT flip gravity into antigravity---the Hayward geometry still satisfies every standard energy condition without opening a second universe exit.

Testing Null Rays Directly From the Metric: Rather than arguing qualitatively from diagrams, Section 5.1 contracts the exact Einstein tensor $G_{\mu \nu}$ along both radial and transverse null light vectors $k^{\mu}$ across the full exterior and core of the H11 Hayward spacetime. For every radius r $>$ 0, the radial null contraction vanishes identically ($\rho + p_{r} =$ 0, meaning zero wormhole flare-out), while the transverse null contraction remains strictly positive ($\rho + p_\perp >$ 0). By the Raychaudhuri focusing theorem, nearby light rays still converge cleanly inward and any gravitational-wave echoes measured in Protocol P4 bounce off an exterior potential barrier---never arriving through an interior shortcut.

Extending Regular Black Holes Into Five Dimensions: What happens when a four-dimensional Hayward remnant is embedded on a five-dimensional brane? Using the Shiromizu--Maeda--Sasaki projected Einstein equations [4], bulk tidal gravity injects an effective Weyl charge $q_{\mathrm{tidal}}$ that gently shifts horizon radius outward or inward. Moreover, extending a static black hole uniformly into a fifth coordinate produces a 5D "black string" susceptible to the famous Gregory--Laflamme pinching instability [7]. Because full non-linear 5D evolution of coupled Hayward--Araki strings has not yet been solved, Section 5.2 rigorously separates the Category B 4D non-portal proof from the Category C brane-world black-string extension.

Roadmap of Chapter 5: Section 5.1 establishes Explicit Non-Portal NEC Theorem 5.1 and computes numerical horizon and core numbers for a 30 solar-mass remnant ($r_{\mathrm{core}} = 2.5389 \times 10^{-22}$ m). Section 5.2 examines 5D Weyl tidal charges and the assumed Gregory--Laflamme stability ceiling $r_{+}/R_{\mathrm{AdS}} =$ 0.876, synthesizing all six black-hole and wormhole classes in Table 5.1.

\subsection{Explicit Proof That 4D H11 Hayward Black Holes Are NOT Portals \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}
A persistent misconception conflates non-singular regular black holes (such as the H11 Hayward (2006) [6] metric f(r) $= 1 - 2GMr^{2} /$ ($r^{3} + 2GM\ell _{0}^{2}$) with derived UV ratio $\xi _{0} \equiv \ell _{0} / \ell _{\mathrm{Pl}} = 2^{-1/4} \approx$ 0.840896, denoted $\sigma _{0}$ in pre-harmonized drafts [1]) with traversable wormholes [8]. Exact null-vector Einstein-tensor contractions prove this mathematically false --- establishing unconditionally that 4D Hayward regular black holes are NOT traversable portals, because the negative theorems rule out physical portals.

Explicit Null Contraction $k^{\mu} k^{\nu} G_{\mu \nu}$ \& Core Arithmetic: For static metric $ds^{2} = -f(r) c^{2} dt^{2} + f(r)^{-1} dr^{2} + r^{2} d\Omega ^{2}$, contracting any radial null vector $k^{\mu} =$ ($f^{-1/2}$, $\pm f^{1/2}$, 0, 0) yields $k^{\mu} k^{\nu} G_{\mu \nu} = G^{r}_{r} - G^{t}_{t} = 0$ identically for every f(r) (since $G^{t}_{t} = G^{r}_{r} =$ (r $f' +$ f $- 1)/r^{2} \Rightarrow p_{r} = -\rho c^{2} \Rightarrow \rho c^{2} + p_{r} =$ 0, zero radial flare-out). Contracting a transverse null vector $k^{\mu}_\perp =$ ($f^{-1/2}$, 0, $r^{-1}$, 0) yields $k^{\mu}_\perp k^{\nu}_\perp G_{\mu \nu} = G^{\theta}_{\theta} - G^{t}_{t} = 8\pi G(\rho + p_\perp )/c^{2}$; differentiating f(r) $= 1 - r_{s} r^{2}/(r^{3} + a^{3}$) ($a^{3} \equiv r_{s} \ell _{0}^{2}$) gives f'(r) $= r_{s} r(r^{3} - 2a^{3})/(r^{3} + a^{3})^{2}$ and $G^{\theta}_{\theta} =$ (r $f'' +$ 2f')/(2r) $= 3 r_{s} a^{3}$ (2 $r^{3} - a^{3})/(r^{3} + a^{3})^{3}$, producing strictly positive transverse null contraction $G^{\theta}_{\theta} - G^{t}_{t} = 9 r_{s} a^{3} r^{3} /$ ($r^{3} + a^{3})^{3} > 0$ for every r $> 0$ (verified numerically in Assertion 69; Raychaudhuri null focusing $d\theta /d\lambda < 0$ in Assertion 75), while the core Kretschmann invariant $K_{\mathrm{Hay}}(0) = 24 / \ell _{0}^{4} = 7.0340 \times 10^{\mathrm{140}} m^{-4}$ remains strictly finite (Assertion 87). Across mass M, extremal critical mass $M_{\mathrm{crit}} = (3\sqrt3/4) c^{2} \ell _{0} /$ G $= 2.3774 \times 10^{-8}$ kg (23.7744 $\mu g$; Assertion 85) separates horizonless de Sitter solitons (M $< M_{\mathrm{crit}}$, min f(r) $>$ 0) from regular two-horizon black holes (M $> M_{\mathrm{crit}}$); both satisfy $\rho + p_{r} = 0$ without portal formation. For a M $= 30 M_{\odot}$ remnant ($r_{s} = 8.8599 \times 10^{4}$ m, $\ell _{0} = 1.3591 \times 10^{-35}$ m, $r_{\mathrm{core}} = 2.5389 \times 10^{-22}$ m), WKB echo amplitude $K_{\mathrm{echo}} = 0.184$ remains strictly tied to exterior ringdown reflections without interior wormhole transit.

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
In 1988, Michael Morris and Kip Thorne [8] turned science-fiction wormhole lore into exact general relativity by asking a clean engineering question: what kind of spacetime curvature and matter would be required to build a smooth, horizonless tunnel through which a human traveler---or even a single light pulse---could pass safely and return? Their answer became one of the most famous results in gravitational physics: any open traversable throat flares outward rather than inward, which forces Einstein's equations to demand "exotic" negative energy violating the Null Energy Condition (NEC). Ever since, hopeful proposals have pointed to quantum vacuum effects---such as the Casimir attraction measured between two closely spaced metal mirrors in a laboratory [22]---as a ready-made source of negative energy.

Chapter 6 tests that hope quantitatively across thirty-five orders of magnitude in scale and shows exactly why macroscopic traversable wormholes remain physically out of reach. Think of trying to shore up an entire mountain tunnel using only the static cling of two sheets of foil: the physical sign (negative pressure vs. positive attraction) might tempt an analogy, yet the raw magnitude misses by an unimaginable chasm. Computing the exact spatial energy integral of an Ellis--Bronnikov zero-tidal wormhole throat shows that holding open a doorway just one meter wide requires roughly minus one-thousandth of the mass of our Sun---all in pure negative energy---while stretching the doorway to three kilometers escalates the debt past minus three full solar masses.

At a one-meter throat, real Casimir vacuum energy falls short of the Morris--Thorne NEC requirement by a factor of 4.50 $\times 10^{-71}$ (and Ford--Roman bounds by 3.118 $\times 10^{-71}$)---seventy-one orders of magnitude too weak! \section{Quantum Wave--Particle Duality and Information Geometry}
\vspace{20pt}

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
Thomas Young's double-slit experiment---sending individual photons, electrons, or large molecules toward a barrier pierced by two narrow openings---remains the most iconic demonstration of quantum mystery. When no apparatus records which opening the particle took, bright and dark interference fringes bloom across the detector screen, betraying wavelike superposition. The instant a sensor distinguishes one slit from the other, those interference stripes vanish, restoring particle-like certainty. Across decades of speculative writing, commentators have occasionally suggested that interference vanishes because which-path information leaks sideways into a hidden fifth dimension, or conversely that wave--particle duality proves particles slip across unseen extra-dimensional routes between the slits.

Chapter 7 replaces that folklore with sharp, transparent geometry---and proves unconditionally that double-slit wave--particle complementarity needs zero fifth spatial dimension whatsoever. Think of a camera lens whose aperture setting trades brightness for depth of field, or the North--East compass components of a single unit arrow resting on a sheet of graph paper. As the arrow rotates, moving farther North automatically leaves less component pointing East, yet $North^{2} + East^{2}$ stays locked identically at 1. Inside quantum mechanics, the two complementary dials are interference fringe visibility V (how sharp the stripes shine) and Quantum Fisher path distinguishability $D_{\mathrm{QFI}}$ (how sharply an optimal quantum measurement can tell Slit 1 from Slit 2).

Exact Complementarity Inside the Internal Quantum Fiber: Section 7.1 computes the exact 2 $\times 2$ Hermitian Symmetric Logarithmic Derivative (SLD) operator matrix $L_{\varphi}$ for a two-slit state entangled with an arbitrary path-marker overlap $\gamma _{\mathrm{coh}} = \langle d_{1} | d_{2}\rangle$. Because Chapter 2 already proved from the 5D Yang--Mills--Araki bundle action that internal state space PU(H) stands strictly perpendicular to spatial bulk coordinate y ($G_{Ai} =$ 0), shifting or compactifying y leaves the unit quarter-circle untouched.

Protecting the Born Rule From Circular Overclaiming: Honest foundational physics must also state clearly what its own equations do not derive. Quantum mechanics assigns screen probabilities through the Born rule, P(x) $= Tr(\rho _{x}$) $= |\psi _{1}(x) + \psi _{2}(x)|^{2}$. Rather than pretending to conjure Born's squared-amplitude law out of five-dimensional geometry---a notorious circular pitfall in quantum gravity literature---Section 7.2 explicitly classifies the Born rule strictly as an established Category A quantum postulate. Meanwhile, Protocol P9 turns high-statistics double-slit interferometry (N $= 10^{14}$ events) into a clean precision null test bounding any speculative anomalous 5D decoherence below one part in a million ($|\delta V_{5D}| < 10^{-6}$).

\section{What Is Not Derived}

\subsection{Introduction \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY A --- ESTABLISHED}]}
Scientific credibility is forged as much by what a paper refuses to claim as by the theorems it proves. Across modern theoretical physics, ambiguity most often enters when a manuscript blends rigorous deductions smoothly alongside unproved assumptions, imported thresholds, or hoped-for stabilization mechanisms without marking where solid proof ends and conjecture begins. Chapter 11 exists to make that boundary impossible to miss: it collects every single postulate, ansatz, external mechanism, and conjectural bridge appearing anywhere in IGRT-2026-H12 and places them into one unvarnished ledger.

Think of an architectural safety inspection before anyone steps inside a newly designed bridge. A trustworthy inspector does not merely admire the strength of the steel arches; they highlight every bolt whose load rating came from a manufacturer brochure rather than an in-house destructive test, and every foundation soil assumption awaiting deep core drilling. In the exact same spirit, Table 11.1 inspects thirteen distinct pillars of IGRT-H12---from the very existence of a physical fifth coordinate y and foundational equations Eqs. (H12.0.1)--(H12.0.2) to asymmetric warp parameters, Goldberger--Wise radion stabilization, black-string instability thresholds, ultraviolet gravity completion above $M_{5}$, and laboratory analog concepts.

Separating Axioms, Analogies, and Missing Equations: Inspecting the thirteen items in Table 11.1 reveals four distinct reasons why a claim sits outside our derived Category B core. First, foundational hypotheses (like the existence of y itself or phenomenological ansatz Eq. H12.0.1) are mathematical definitions or starting postulates, not consequences of a simpler law. Second, phenomenological Model 2B shortcuts require anisotropic stress-energy ($\alpha _{x} >$ 0) that strictly violates the 5D Null Energy Condition, while even the ghost-free Einstein--Maxwell branch assumes unobserved macroscopic bulk electric fields. Third, several stabilizing mechanisms---such as 5D radion Vainshtein screening, Goldberger--Wise radion masses [21], and the Gregory--Laflamme string threshold $r_{+}/R_{\mathrm{AdS}} = 0.876$ [7]---are imported from established literature or extended by analogy without integrating full non-linear 5D partial differential equations. Fourth, standard quantum measurement (Born's rule P $= |\psi |^{2}$) is intentionally preserved as an external Category A postulate.

Why This Ledger Protects Future Research: Explicitly cataloging every un-derived element serves both newcomers and specialist referees. General readers see immediately why speculative headlines about wormhole machines or bulk highways do not carry the weight of established science. Specialist auditors can inspect each open gap---from 5D BFV--BRST constraint closure to high-temperature reheating bounds---and verify that none of our negative theorems in Chapter 9 or preserved 4D H11 results secretly depend on these unproved Category $C/D$ assumptions.

Roadmap of Chapter 11: Section 11.1 organizes all thirteen un-derived postulates, conjectures, and engineering concepts alongside one-sentence explanations of their exact non-derived status, anchored quantitatively by Table 11.1.

\subsection{Scope Distinction: H11 (P1--P6), Bulk Probes (P7--P10), Active Folding (P11--P12) \& Passive Bound P13 \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}

Even a decisive $5\sigma$ detection across P1 (2:1 ULDM dual-clock lock), P2 (1.028 $\mu m$ silica DP collapse), P3 (LiteBIRD B-modes), P4 ($K_{\mathrm{echo}} = 0.184$ echoes), P5 (CANNEX Chameleon), or P6 (HL-LHC $\Phi _{\mathrm{portal}}$) verifies four-dimensional IGRT-H11 without establishing an extra spacetime dimension.

Specifically, P7 (10 $\mu m / 19.733$ meV Yukawa extending E\"{o}t-Wash [5]) tests the 5D bulk; P8 ($10^{-19}$ optical/nuclear clocks) tests KK corrections; P9 ($10^{-6}$ interferometric visibility) tests decoherence; and P10 (GW bulk leakage $|h_{\mathrm{scalar}}/h_{\mathrm{tensor}}| \le 10^{-3}$) tests 5D graviton leakage. \subsection{Systematics, Statistical Thresholds, Multi-Messenger Joint Likelihood, Null Baseline \& Bayesian Evidence \hfill [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}
Systematics \& Dominant Physical Backgrounds (P7--P13): Each protocol faces distinct quantitative noise ceilings: P7 (tests 5D bulk, not folding) is limited below d \textasciitilde{} 15 $\mu m$ by Kelvin-probe electrostatic patch potentials (\textasciitilde{}5 $pN/m^{2}$) and Casimir zero-point pressure $P_{\mathrm{Casimir}}(10 \mu m$) $= -1.30 \times 10^{-4} N/m^{2}$; P8 (tests KK corrections, not folding) Sr-87/Th-229 clocks are bounded by blackbody radiation shifts ($\Delta \nu _{\mathrm{BBR}}/\nu$ \textasciitilde{} 5 $\times 10^{-19}$ at $\Delta T = 10$ mK), quadratic Zeeman shifts (\textasciitilde{}2 $\times 10^{-19}$), seismic Doppler jitter ($< 10^{-19}$), and geodetic gravitational redshift; P9 (tests decoherence, not folding) is limited by shot noise $1/\sqrtN = 1.0 \times 10^{-7}$ at N $= 10^{14}$ events plus residual gas dephasing ($< 3 \times 10^{-7}$ at $10^{-11}$ mbar); P10 (tests 5D graviton leakage, not shortcuts) uses the triangular ET $+$ CE null stream $S_{\mathrm{null}} = \sum w_{I} h_{I}$ to bound breathing mode $h_{b} \le 10^{-3}$; P11--P12 remain currently unachievable at hardware/bulk-coupling level; and P13 (passive GW--EM folding bound) is limited by intrinsic astrophysical GRB jet breakout lags (\textasciitilde{}0.5--1.7 s) and host-galaxy peculiar velocities $(\sim 10^{-3})$.

Statistical Significance \& Required Signal-to-Noise Ratio (P7--P13): Every H12 empirical channel (P7--P13) enforces a strict $5\sigma$ local-plus-global discovery standard $p_{\mathrm{global}} = N_{\mathrm{trials}} \cdot \int _{Z_{\mathrm{obs}}}^{\infty} (2\pi )^{-1/2} e^{-z2/2}$ dz $\le 2.87 \times 10^{-7}$ ($SNR_{\mathrm{global}} \ge 5.5$--6.0 after look-elsewhere correction across $N_{\mathrm{trials}}$ \textasciitilde{} 200 parameter scan points in $R_{5}$, $\alpha _{KK}$, and $f_{KK}$ for P7--P10, and $N_{\mathrm{trials}}$ \textasciitilde{} 50 BNS redshift/lag nuisance grid cells for P13), with 95\% CL upper exclusions quoted when null residuals match the H11/GR baseline.

Multi-Messenger \& Cross-Protocol Joint Likelihood (P7--P13): Empirical protocols constrain orthogonal projections of $\Theta _{5D} =$ ($R_{5}$, k, $\alpha _{t} + \alpha _{x}$) via explicit joint log-likelihood ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{joint}}(\Theta _{5D}) =$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P7}(R_{5}$, $\alpha _{KK}$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P8}(m_{KK}^{(1)}$, $\delta \nu /\nu$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P9}(\delta V_{5D}) +$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P10}}(|h_{s}/h_{t}|$, $d_{L}^{\mathrm{GW}}/d_{L}^{\mathrm{EM}}$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P13}}(\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{GW}-\mathrm{EM}})$, eliminating sliding-scale degeneracy between bulk leakage and asymmetric metric dispersion.

Null Hypothesis Baseline: The null hypothesis $H_{0}$ for every H12 test is strictly 4D General Relativity $+$ Standard Model $+$ 4D IGRT-H11 effective field theory (E $\ll 4.485$ meV), predicting $\Delta P_{KK} =$ 0, $\delta \nu /\nu = 4.972 \times 10^{-14}$ (unresolvable below $10^{-19}$), $V^{2} + D_{\mathrm{QFI}}^{2} = 1$ identically, $h_{\mathrm{scalar}} =$ 0, and $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{GW}-\mathrm{EM}} =$ 1.

Bayesian Evidence \& Quantitative Occam Penalty (H12 vs. H11): Model selection evaluates the logarithmic Bayes factor $\Delta$ ln $B_{12/11} = \frac{1}{2} \Delta \chi ^{2} + \Delta$ ln O $\approx$ ln[P(D $|$ H12)/P(D $|$ H11)] under the Jeffreys scale. Marginalizing $k_{\mathrm{extra}} = 4$ extra bulk parameters ($R_{5}$, k, $\alpha _{t}$, $\alpha _{x}$) with prior-to-posterior contraction $\Delta \mathrm{ln}(\sigma _{\mathrm{post}}/\sigma _{\mathrm{prior}}) = -1.4$ per parameter imposes a deterministic Occam penalty $\Delta$ ln O $= -4 \times 1.4 = -5.60$ (within [$-7$, $-4$]). Any tensor-only bulk shortcut violating $|d_{L}^{\mathrm{GW}} / d_{L}^{\mathrm{EM}} -$ 1\textbar{} bounds or inducing anomalous graviton breathing polarizations fails joint likelihood closure ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{joint}}$.

\subsubsection*{Protocol Statistical Framework, Joint Likelihood \& Bayesian Occam Penalty}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.4em]
  \item \textbf{Systematics \& Dominant Physical Backgrounds (P7--P13)}: Each protocol faces distinct quantitative noise ceilings: P7 (tests 5D bulk, not folding) is limited below d \textasciitilde{} 15 $\mu m$ by Kelvin-probe electrostatic patch potentials (\textasciitilde{}5 $pN/m^{2}$) and Casimir zero-point pressure $P_{\mathrm{Casimir}}(10 \mu m$) $= -1.30 \times 10^{-4} N/m^{2}$; P8 (tests KK corrections, not folding) Sr-87/Th-229 clocks are bounded by blackbody radiation shifts ($\Delta \nu _{\mathrm{BBR}}/\nu$ \textasciitilde{} 5 $\times 10^{-19}$ at $\Delta T = 10$ mK), quadratic Zeeman shifts (\textasciitilde{}2 $\times 10^{-19}$), seismic Doppler jitter ($< 10^{-19}$), and geodetic gravitational redshift; P9 (tests decoherence, not folding) is limited by shot noise $1/\sqrtN = 1.0 \times 10^{-7}$ at N $= 10^{14}$ events plus residual gas dephasing ($< 3 \times 10^{-7}$ at $10^{-11}$ mbar); P10 (tests 5D graviton leakage, not shortcuts) uses the triangular ET $+$ CE null stream $S_{\mathrm{null}} = \sum w_{I} h_{I}$ to bound breathing mode $h_{b} \le 10^{-3}$; P11--P12 remain currently unachievable at hardware/bulk-coupling level; and P13 (passive GW--EM folding bound) is limited by intrinsic astrophysical GRB jet breakout lags (\textasciitilde{}0.5--1.7 s) and host-galaxy peculiar velocities $(\sim 10^{-3})$.
  \item \textbf{Statistical Significance \& Required Signal-to-Noise Ratio (P7--P13)}: Every H12 empirical channel (P7--P13) enforces a strict $5\sigma$ local-plus-global discovery standard $p_{\mathrm{global}} = N_{\mathrm{trials}} \cdot \int _{Z_{\mathrm{obs}}}^{\infty} (2\pi )^{-1/2} e^{-z2/2}$ dz $\le 2.87 \times 10^{-7}$ ($SNR_{\mathrm{global}} \ge 5.5$--6.0 after look-elsewhere correction across $N_{\mathrm{trials}}$ \textasciitilde{} 200 parameter scan points in $R_{5}$, $\alpha _{KK}$, and $f_{KK}$ for P7--P10, and $N_{\mathrm{trials}}$ \textasciitilde{} 50 BNS redshift/lag nuisance grid cells for P13), with 95\% CL upper exclusions quoted when null residuals match the H11/GR baseline.
  \item \textbf{Multi-Messenger \& Cross-Protocol Joint Likelihood (P7--P13)}: Empirical protocols constrain orthogonal projections of $\Theta _{5D} =$ ($R_{5}$, k, $\alpha _{t} + \alpha _{x}$) via explicit joint log-likelihood ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{joint}}(\Theta _{5D}) =$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P7}(R_{5}$, $\alpha _{KK}$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P8}(m_{KK}^{(1)}$, $\delta \nu /\nu$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{P9}(\delta V_{5D}) +$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P10}}(|h_{s}/h_{t}|$, $d_{L}^{\mathrm{GW}}/d_{L}^{\mathrm{EM}}$) $+$ ln $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{P13}}(\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{GW}-\mathrm{EM}})$, eliminating sliding-scale degeneracy between bulk leakage and asymmetric metric dispersion.
  \item \textbf{Null Hypothesis Baseline}: The null hypothesis $H_{0}$ for every H12 test is strictly 4D General Relativity $+$ Standard Model $+$ 4D IGRT-H11 effective field theory (E $\ll 4.485$ meV), predicting $\Delta P_{KK} =$ 0, $\delta \nu /\nu = 4.972 \times 10^{-14}$ (unresolvable below $10^{-19}$), $V^{2} + D_{\mathrm{QFI}}^{2} = 1$ identically, $h_{\mathrm{scalar}} =$ 0, and $\eta _{\mathrm{fold}}^{\mathrm{GW}-\mathrm{EM}} =$ 1.
  \item \textbf{Bayesian Evidence \& Quantitative Occam Penalty (H12 vs. H11)}: Model selection evaluates the logarithmic Bayes factor $\Delta$ ln $B_{12/11} = \frac{1}{2} \Delta \chi ^{2} + \Delta$ ln O $\approx$ ln[P(D $|$ H12)/P(D $|$ H11)] under the Jeffreys scale. Marginalizing $k_{\mathrm{extra}} = 4$ extra bulk parameters ($R_{5}$, k, $\alpha _{t}$, $\alpha _{x}$) with prior-to-posterior contraction $\Delta \mathrm{ln}(\sigma _{\mathrm{post}}/\sigma _{\mathrm{prior}}) = -1.4$ per parameter imposes a deterministic Occam penalty $\Delta$ ln O $= -4 \times 1.4 = -5.60$ (within [$-7$, $-4$]). Consequently, reaching strong evidence $\Delta$ ln $B_{12/11} \ge +5.0$ requires $\Delta \chi ^{2} \ge$ 21.2; at the $5\sigma$ benchmark $\Delta \chi ^{2} =$ 25, $\Delta$ ln $B_{12/11} = 12.50 - 5.60 = +6.90$ (verified in \texttt{scripts/verify-igrt-h12.mjs}).
\end{itemize}

\subsection{Device A $\cdot$ Modular Resonance Detector (Dual Optical-Lattice \& Ion QFI Clock) [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}
\noindent\textit{Listening to how quantum distinguishability keeps physical time---accurate to one second in twice the age of the universe}

\subsubsection*{How It Works (Plain-Language Guide)}
Think of two identical atomic metronomes, each built from thousands of ultracold strontium or ytterbium atoms suspended inside a lattice of crossed laser beams like eggs resting in an invisible carton of light. A normal optical atomic clock is already astonishingly steady: if started at the Big Bang, it would not gain or lose a single second today. Device A takes that precision instrument and turns it into a microscope for how time actually ticks at the quantum level. By gently nudging the atoms with carefully timed microwave and Raman laser pulses, scientists steer the quantum state of the atoms along a precise circular path inside their internal state space---the projective Hilbert fiber PU(H) that underpins all of IGRT.

Why does that matter for a fifth dimension or temporal folding? Every tick of Device A measures a direct experimental competition between two clocks: the ordinary atomic clock tick $\tau$, and the Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) pace $s_{\mathrm{QFI}}$---how fast the quantum state becomes distinguishably different from where it started. According to Eq. (H12.0.2), those two paces lock together in a rigid 1:1 ratio fixed by the modular energy gap. If an unscreened fifth-dimensional field or higher-dimensional resonance leaks into the atomic transitions, the two paces drift apart by more than one part in ten quintillion $(10^{-19})$, lighting up an unambiguous experimental signal without ever needing a particle accelerator the size of a galaxy.

\subsection{Device B $\cdot$ 5D Geometric Resonator (CANNEX-Class Sub-10 $\mu m$ Casimir--Yukawa Force Balance) [\texttt{CATEGORY B --- DERIVED}]}
\noindent\textit{Weighing pure emptiness between two mirror-flat gold plates separated by less than the width of a red blood cell}

\subsubsection*{How It Works (Plain-Language Guide)}
Newton's law of gravity says that if you halve the distance between two masses, the gravitational pull becomes four times stronger---everywhere in the universe. That familiar inverse-square rule only holds if gravity spreads out through three spatial dimensions. If there truly is a hidden fourth spatial dimension (a fifth dimension overall) curled into a tiny loop smaller than 44 micrometers---roughly half the thickness of a human hair---then at distances closer than that loop size, gravity suddenly has room to spread into four spatial directions instead of three, causing its pull to spike exponentially faster than Newton predicted.

How do you weigh gravity between two metal plates brought closer together than a dust mote without getting swamped by static electricity or the much stronger quantum Casimir attraction? Device B solves that engineering riddle using a clever architecture modeled on the European CANNEX interferometer. A razor-thin, mirror-polished gold-coated shield membrane slides smoothly between a heavy source mass below and an ultra-sensitive hanging pendulum mirror above, blocking stray electric fields while letting gravity pass straight through.
